#EmbeddedSys #RTOS #FirmwareDev #HWIntegration #Cplusplus #NexGenSystems  

Hey there—let’s cut the fluff. I’m Helen Park, a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer at NexGen Systems, where I’ve spent the last 3 years turning chaos into code. My days? A mix of soldering, debugging, and rewriting legacy systems to run 3x faster.  

I own the firmware for our flagship industrial IoT platform—reduced boot latency by 40% and slashed crash rates to <0.5%. When hardware and software clash? I’m the glue. Recently, I architected a real-time RTOS solution that scaled our edge devices from 100 to 1,000 nodes without hiccups.  

C/C++? My comfort zone. I’ve shipped production firmware for 5+ embedded devices, from smart sensors to industrial controllers. My work? It’s in the field, running 24/7, saving companies time and money.  

Not here to flex—just here to say I’m good at what I do. Let’s connect if you’re building the future, not just keeping up with it.  

*Skills: C/C++ (embedded), Firmware Dev, RTOS, HW-SW Integration, Python, REST APIs, IoT Protocols*
